```yaml
name: Publish to Ubuntu PPA

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Version to publish (defaults to release tag)'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish-ppa:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Free disk space
        uses: jlumbroso/free-disk-space@main
        with:
          android: true
          dotnet: true
          haskell: true
          large-packages: true
          docker-images: true
          preinstalled-runtimes: true
          tool-cache: true
          swap-storage: true

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Determine version
        id: version
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "release" ]; then
            VERSION="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}"
          else
            VERSION="${{ github.event.inputs.version }}"
          fi
          if [ -z "$VERSION" ]; then
            VERSION=$(cargo pkgid | cut -d# -f2)
          fi
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Build Debian package
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y devscripts debhelper dh-make dpkg-dev fakeroot
          
          # Create a simple debian directory structure if not present
          # Note: This assumes the project has a debian/ directory configured for mise
          # If not, this step would need to be adapted to generate it or use a different packaging method
          
          # Build the binary first
          cargo build --release
          
          # Create package
          dpkg-buildpackage -us -uc -b

      - name: Import GPG key
        run: |
          echo "${{ secrets.PPA_GPG_KEY }}" | gpg --batch --import
        env:
          GPG_TTY: $(tty)

      - name: Publish to PPA
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y devscripts debhelper dh-make dpkg-dev fakeroot dput
          
          # Configure dput
          mkdir -p ~/.dput.cf
          cat > ~/.dput.cf << EOF
          [ppa]
          fqdn = ppa.launchpad.net
          method = ftp
          incoming = ~${PPA_TEAM}/ppa/${PPA_NAME}/
          login = anonymous
          allow_unsigned_uploads = 0
          EOF
          
          # Upload the .changes file
          dput ppa ../mise_${VERSION}_amd64.changes
        env:
          GPG_TTY: $(tty)
          PPA_TEAM: ${{ secrets.PPA_TEAM }}
          PPA_NAME: ${{ secrets.PPA_NAME }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
```
